sections.heading: the state of *play*
sections.body:
Most live threads are in the same state: the making is done, the sending isn't — client work sits approved and undelivered, an offer sits ready without a named buyer, a studio sits built with no pilot run, and the listening engine keeps filing posts the system has no record of anyone publishing. The genuinely new thing this window is a verdict arguing the current lead offer should be parked.

Each thread below has its own brief. Open the one you're resuming — it carries the resume line, what it made, and what's still open.

sections.heading: what this board *isn't*
sections.body:
Everything here is assembled from what the harness recorded. Sends, posts, calls and client reactions happen off-system, so an empty outcome column means "not logged", not "not done". Several threads also carry titles captured from unrelated finalize notes, and most quality scores are self-assigned rather than judged against real published work.

212 more threads cleared the bar but sit below the 12-card ceiling and were not carded: linkedin profile content, benoit vatere, kallaway hook mastery, teardown 1 fresh, farrice brand, health performance ip library, voice identity stack, mission, writers room, listing content, profile copy fresh 0730 packet, linkedin launch.

235 keys were seen but never declared a thread (no live handoff, no open mission, no finalized deliverable) — activity alone does not mint a mission.
